simple.scope: Six simple/blog themes from awesome-halo. Read-only source review; no installation, builds, runtime validation or business-code changes.
simple.method: Downloaded each named current default/Halo2 branch via GitHub codeload, retained text files and complete path list, inspected README/license/package/theme/settings/layout/index/post and plugin references. Upstream licenses fetched directly from official raw GitHub URLs. No GitHub API token used.
simple.commonInference: Core blog layouts can be adapted to existing Next.js components and CMS content APIs. Halo Thymeleaf, finder calls, widget elements and old jQuery/Alpine scripts cannot be installed unchanged. Porting scope is existing CMS pages, search and comments; moments/photos/friend-link pages, visitor counts, likes, RSS and full upstream settings need separately matched capabilities. Difficulty is source-based estimation, not measured implementation.

themes.recommendation: 首批候选；直接从 MIT 原作移植布局与所需样式，或使用经核实的 Halo MIT 部分，保留对应作者和许可声明。
themes.difficulty: 中。原作 Astro/Svelte，Halo 版仍用 Astro/Svelte/Vue 构建后生成 Thymeleaf，须转 React。
themes.coreDependencyFinding: 已检查 index.astro -> MainGridLayout/Layout -> PostList/PostCard 和 Navbar/SideBar。文章主列表只用 posts.items；未发现额外 Halo 插件会阻断主博客首页。默认侧栏为分类/标签。Search.svelte 交互时请求 /apis/api.halo.run/v1alpha1/indices/-/search，具有 catch，可用现有 CMS 搜索替换。
themes.mvp: 圆角卡片、侧栏、封面/无封面列表、响应式导航、文章/独立页/分类标签/搜索/分页/评论、现有主题预览与基础设置；正文复用已净化 HTML。若需要与原作相同的个性横幅和头像，应增加受控图片设置，否则使用站点 Logo 和本地自有背景。
themes.notInMvp: 图库、瞬间、友情链接管理、音乐/Meting、任意 HTML 小部件、访客自由色相、完整国际化、原作 Markdown 扩展/GitHub 卡片、代码高亮插件及原版所有动画。多级菜单需保留 CMS 能力，Halo Fuwari 的配置只声称一级菜单。

themes.name: Retypeset / 重新编排
themes.license: MIT / Copyright 2025 radishzz（原作）与 picsky（Halo 适配）；package.json、theme.yaml 也声明 MIT，无发现矛盾
themes.recommendation: 首批候选；原作 Astro 或 Halo 模板均可作为授权来源转 React，保留实际所用来源的署名和许可。
themes.difficulty: 低至中。主要是留白、窄栏、文本列表、侧边导航与文章目录，核心数据和当前 CMS 接近。
themes.coreDependencyFinding: index/post 是普通 Thymeleaf 内容模板；数学和搜索不是核心页面的强制依赖。src/main.ts 对 Vditor、KaTeX、MathJax、Mermaid 都检测函数存在才调用；搜索检测 SearchWidget.open。layout 通过 pluginFinder.available('PluginMoments') 决定瞬间入口。没有数学库照样可以呈现普通正文。
themes.mvp: 书籍式阅读留白、文本列表、日期、侧边导航、正文标题层次、目录、分类标签、独立页面、现有 CMS 搜索/评论、预览和基础设置；使用系统字体。
themes.notInMvp: 原作全部语言、LaTeX/Mermaid/MDX、外部评论系统、瞬间、自定义 CSS/Head、原作自制客户端路由与所有形变转场。搜索按钮替换 CMS 搜索，不能保留无效果的 SearchWidget 调用。
themes.assetCaution: base-head.html 预载 EarlySummer、Snell-Black-SF、Snell-Bold-SF、STIX 字体。根 MIT 不能替代逐字体核验；尤其 Snell 来源/再分发授权本次未确认，首版不复制这些字体，视觉验收不承诺字形完全相同。

themes.name: Chirpy
themes.license: 声明不一致：根 LICENSE 与 README 是 MIT（AirboZH 2023），package.json 标 GPL-3.0。移植 Halo 版前需澄清范围。
themes.recommendation: 可选候选，但优先从 MIT 的 Jekyll 原作改造，不混入 Halo 版新增代码来回避其声明冲突。
themes.difficulty: 中。Liquid/Thymeleaf 转 React，技术博客侧栏、目录和分类结构可映射。
themes.dependencies: Halo README 明确全部效果需 halo-plugin-chirpy。核心博客可复用 CMS 数据；原作搜索/评论要替换，PWA、统计、数学、Mermaid、原作多评论系统为额外功能。默认头像/favicon 来自 ClipartMAX，不直接复制。

themes.name: Clarity
themes.license: GPL-3.0（LICENSE、README、package.json 和 theme.yaml 一致）
themes.upstreamLicense: 原作项目代码 MIT / Copyright 2024 Zhilu；README 将博客文章另列为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
themes.recommendation: 后续候选。若采用 MIT 原作路线，需要直接从 blog-v3 的 Nuxt/Vue 源码改造并保留署名，不混入 GPL Halo 版特有代码；如采用 Halo 版则另处理 GPL 组合发布要求。
themes.difficulty: 中至高。三栏布局可适配，完整小部件和特殊内容块明显超出现有设置。
themes.dependencies: Halo 核心博客加可选插件/外部功能：天气 API、瞬间、Twikoo、友链 RSS（theme.yaml 注明 plugin-links >=2.2.0）、海报生成、统计、自定义 HTML、复杂文章块。首版可只用三栏文章/目录与 CMS 评论搜索。

themes.name: S1mp1e
themes.license: GPL-3.0（LICENSE 和 theme.yaml）
themes.upstreamLicense: 仓库标记 generated from theme-starter；本次未进一步复核 starter 具体版本，不将其视为替代授权路线。
themes.recommendation: 技术可改、优先级较低；与现有简约主题接近，并需处理 GPL 发布要求。
themes.difficulty: 低。简单 Thymeleaf 列表、标语、上下页和普通正文。
themes.dependencies: 核心首页没有另一个内容插件；文章和独立页通过 halo:comment 接评论，替换现有 CMS 评论。配置仅三种颜色和基础站点资料。

themes.name: Next（AeroWang 版）
themes.license: GPL-3.0（根 LICENSE）
themes.upstreamLicense: README 未声明另一主题原作；不能推断全部附带资源授权。
themes.recommendation: 技术可改、后续候选，不因同属 Next.js 就当成可直接复用组件。
themes.difficulty: 中。package.json 是 Next 13.4/React 18；依赖 Halo 2.7 API、原有路由、ISR 和 Basic Auth。需接 CMS 公共 API 与实时 SSR，保持 CMS 权限/预览语义。
themes.dependencies: README 明确独立部署且不能在 Halo 后台直接安装；归档搁置，搜索/点赞/统计仍列 TODO。动态/友链路由需要对应能力。核心博客可改，完整性仍需补足并处理 GPL 组合发布要求。

complex.scope: Read-only source and licence triage. These are adaptation estimates, not completed ports or legal clearance of every bundled asset.

themes.name: Stellar
themes.license: MIT; upstream xaoxuu/hexo-theme-stellar also MIT
themes.priority: Suitable early candidate when limited to blog layout
themes.feasibility: Sidebar navigation, card article stream, reading column, archive, search and comments can use existing CMS data. Port Thymeleaf fragments to React and scope CSS.
themes.gaps: Full documentation/column product is separate scope. Current theme includes topic/category templates and many document-related settings; do not promise full documentation runtime from the ordinary blog port. Links, moments and photos are optional plugin pages absent from current CMS.

themes.name: Stack
themes.license: GPL-3.0; upstream CaiJimmy/hugo-theme-stack also GPL-3.0
themes.priority: Strong blog candidate after combination/distribution licence decision
themes.feasibility: Three-column card layout and reading page map well to current article/category/tag/search/comment data. Source has maintainable SCSS and TS with Vite. Replace Halo search/comment integration and Thymeleaf fragments.
themes.gaps: Photo album, moments and friend-link pages require additional domain support if retained. Core blog does not require those. TOC, theme mode and code-copy interactions need frontend adaptation.

themes.name: Hao
themes.license: GPL-3.0. README identifies Heo/Butterfly ancestry. Butterfly upstream currently Apache-2.0; precise Heo-derived assets were not exhaustively traced.
themes.priority: Later visual-rich batch, with licence/source inventory
themes.feasibility: Core cover cards, article details, sidebar and category navigation are feasible. Existing pages can support a reduced blog edition without backend entity changes.
themes.gaps: Very extensive settings (over 100 KB YAML) and frontend behaviours. README explicitly makes plugins optional, including links, moments, bangumi, gallery, equipment, KaTeX and donations. Full fidelity would expand scope greatly; map search/comments to CMS and postpone those separate domains.

themes.name: Ocean
themes.license: GPL-3.0; README identifies GPL Earth as base
themes.priority: Separate knowledge-base style batch; technically simpler than full document system
themes.feasibility: Public knowledge-base presentation actually uses categories, tags, menus and posts. Homepage calls categoryFinder.listAsTree, menuFinder.getByName, postFinder.listByCategory/listByTag. Core can reuse current entities with new view queries/configuration.
themes.gaps: Category icons/covers/descriptions/colour metadata and structured module settings need explicit mapping. Article likes/visit stats and cursor navigation are not simply a CSS change. Do not invent separate knowledge-base entities just to render category/post views.

themes.name: HeoLink
themes.license: Apache-2.0
themes.priority: Wait for link-directory capability, or deliberately implement a simpler menu-based directory
themes.feasibility: Navigation style is feasible, but its core homepage is grouped website links, not an article list. Existing menus only cover a reduced edition.
themes.gaps: index.html directly calls linkFinder.groupBy and consumes group/item visibility flags, logo, description, related article and external icon service settings. Full adaptation needs link/group management and decisions about login-only visibility. An article detail template exists but is secondary.

themes.name: Mcnav
themes.license: GPL-3.0; upstream fordes123/ITEM is GPL-3.0
themes.priority: Wait for link-directory capability and licence decision
themes.feasibility: Navigation dashboard layout can be ported, but faithfully implementing its homepage requires grouped links and selected hot link groups. It is not an ordinary blog skin.
themes.gaps: Homepage calls linkFinder.groupBy/listBy and postFinder.getByName for link-to-article association. Need link metadata/management for equivalent functionality. Blog-style pages alone would remove its defining feature.

themes.name: Halorum
themes.license: BSD-3-Clause; upstream mulingyuer/Typecho_Theme_JJ is also BSD-3-Clause, original copyright preserved in Halo LICENSE
themes.priority: Later forum-style blog edition; full community is separate work
themes.feasibility: Three-column forum-looking article feed and comment presentation can reuse existing posts/categories/comments. Source uses Astro to produce Halo templates, so rebuild components in React.
themes.gaps: Current generated templates call /uc/posts/editor, /uc/notifications, /apis/notification.halo.run/v1alpha1/notifications, user profile and comments APIs. Full version needs public account/user-centre, notification, posting permissions, replies/activity ordering and visit/like statistics. Do not expose non-working controls or enable raw custom HTML/JS setting options from upstream.

themes.name: Moderna
themes.license: Halo repository MIT, but imported CSS identifies BootstrapMade Moderna v4.11.0 and points to BootstrapMade licence. Upstream present terms prohibit mass redistribution as CMS themes; no separate grant located.
themes.priority: Hold copying/distribution until explicit upstream grant or choose an independently implemented alternative
themes.feasibility: Corporate landing/about/services/team/contact/blog layouts are technically portable using structured options and existing pages, but root MIT alone does not clear inherited assets.
themes.gaps: Corporate page templates and structured service/team/carousel data differ from current three-field theme options. Most important blocker is upstream distribution permission, not framework compatibility. A normal Pro/Premium purchase is not stated to allow CMS mass redistribution.
